entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse. My order number is VF789012.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up your order... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It's a preference. The band just isn't as comfortable as I'd hoped. I know it's been a little while, but I did try to return it much earlier.
I see. The system shows it was delivered 32 days ago. Our policy is pretty clear on timelines, but let's see what happened.

Right, I understand. I actually tried to process the return on day 9, but there was a huge website error. The whole returns portal was showing a 'system down' message, and I absolutely couldn't print a shipping label. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I had a feeling I might need it.

A screenshot, that's smart. I appreciate you telling me that. Let me check our system log for any reported outages around December 24th... And yes, you are absolutely right. I see a note here about a major service disruption that day. I'm very sorry you were impacted by that.
It was frustrating, but I figured it was just holiday traffic. So, given that, is there any way to process it now? Perhaps a partial credit if a full refund isn't possible?

Well, let's look at the standard policy first. Even without that website issue, you're still in good shape. I'm checking the product return window here, and my knowledge base shows that all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? I thought it might be shorter for electronics. That's great.
Yes, 90 days. Since you're only on day 32, you are well within the return period. There's no need for any exception. I can approve this for a full refund right now.
Wow, that's much easier than I expected. Thank you, Isaac.

Of course. I've just generated a new prepaid return label and sent it to the email address on file. Just pack the device in its original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see the refund in about 3 to 5 business days.
Perfect. That's all I needed. I appreciate your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
